How it works in the group

Spin just for fun — the coins are make-believe and there's nothing to buy. Wins pay left to right on 9 lines across the 5 reels: match 3, 4, or 5 symbols along a line to win. The Cove Wave is wild and stands in for any symbol.

Hold & Win — the bubble bonus: gold coins float inside bubbles on the reels. Land 6 or more Bubble Coins anywhere and the bonus starts: those bubbles lock in place and you get 3 respins. Only the empty spots spin. Every new bubble that lands locks too — and resets your respins back to 3. The bonus ends when your respins run out, and you collect every coin in every bubble. Fill the whole board with bubbles and you also win the GRAND — 500× your bet!

Jackpot bubbles: some bubbles carry a jackpot instead of a number — MINI pays 15× your bet, MINOR pays 50×, and the rare MAJOR pays 250×.

Your coins are how you earn your way toward prizes. Build up your balance, take a screenshot showing your coin total, and post it in the Creator's Cove Facebook group — that's your entry. Winners are picked from the screenshots posted in the group.

Hit the Hold & Win bonus or a big line win? Tap WINNER CARD for an extra-pretty screenshot to post in the group.

Run out of coins? Your next 100 free coins arrive tomorrow — when you hit zero, a countdown timer appears on the machine showing exactly how long is left until midnight. Come back tomorrow, tap to claim your 100, and you're spinning again. Your coin balance is saved on this device, so it's right where you left it when you come back — your session scores start fresh each visit.

Paytable

    Line payouts are × your bet, for 3, 4, or 5 of a kind paying left to right on a line. Only the best win on each line counts — but different lines can all win on the same spin. Bubble Coins don't pay on lines; 6 or more anywhere start the Hold & Win bonus. Bubble coin values are × your bet too: most bubbles hold 1–10 coins per bet coin, with MINI (15×), MINOR (50×) and MAJOR (250×) jackpot bubbles mixed in — and a full board of 15 bubbles adds the 500× GRAND.
